_meta.purpose: Feature-activation map for pairwise integration tests driven over CDP. Every statement verified against source on 2026-08-21.
_meta.executionContext: All app chunks are classic scripts (index.html loads them via plain or dynamically-inserted <script> tags, never modules, except js/16 and js/23 which are type=module). Top-level function declarations (update, multiSplat, recStartRecording, setMultiplierHotkey, ...) therefore land on window, and top-level let/const (animationMultiplier, isPaused, recEnabled, pointer, obstacle, ...) are global lexical bindings reachable from CDP Runtime.evaluate at global scope. js/23-depth-collision.js is a module but exposes everything via window.collisionLayers / window.depthEstimator.
_meta.coordinateSpace: x,y for splat/stamp helpers are canvas BACKING-STORE pixels, y-down (canvas.width/canvas.height). multiplayer/scheduleStrokeReplay events are normalized 0..1.
_meta.clockNotes: The sim clock is dt = min(wallDt/subSteps, 16ms) * window.timeScale computed in update() (js/05j-update-loop.js:80-115). window.__simDtMs / __simTimeMs are published per frame. Several feature-local animation loops (light source, light shift, audio tick) run their OWN rAF with 15ms performance.now() gates and are NOT on the sim clock - pin performance.now/Date.now or freeze those features for determinism.

Import a full coverage canvas: window.Masks.importCoverage(canvasEl, 'name') (js/05o-masks.js:175-190). Overlay film without painting: window.config.MASK_OVERLAY = true (js/05j-update-loop.js:1275). config.BRUSH_TARGET direct write is exactly what the UI's setBrushTarget does (js/20-mixer-layout.js:3050-3058) minus button classes and settings persistence. */
features.deactivate: window.config.BRUSH_TARGET = 'fluid'; window.config.MASK_OVERLAY = false;  /* the Mask objects themselves persist; remove with window.Masks.remove(id) or wipe coverage with window.Masks.clear(id) (js/05o-masks.js:45-72) */
touchesSharedState: maskStore dye-res RGBA8 FBOs (js/05o-masks.js:20-21) - created at current dyeTexWidth/Height
config.BRUSH_TARGET - reroutes ALL brush dabs away from the fluid (js/05j-update-loop.js:394-409); config.MASK_OVERLAY
Display pass: red overlay film sampled on texture unit 7 whenever BRUSH_TARGET==='mask' or MASK_OVERLAY (js/05j-update-loop.js:1275-1278,1312-1313); suppressed during window.__exporting

Mask stamping reads config.BRUSH_ERASER / BRUSH_FLOW / BRUSH_HARDNESS / SPLAT_RADIUS * STAMP_RADIUS_SCALE (js/05i-sim-stats.js:311-342) - so materialModes 'clay' (STAMP_RADIUS_SCALE=1.3) changes mask brush footprint

Consumers that READ mask coverage: colliders (createFromMask/setMaskLive, js/23-depth-collision.js:274-276,905-934,1141), raster-layer clip bindings (layer.clipMaskId -> display units 8-11, js/05l-layers-transform.js:739-743), image-layer CSS masks (window.applyLayerClip readback, js/05m-layer-masks.js:17-61)
Shared sketch/mask undo ring (window.__maskUndoPush, entries tagged kind:'mask')

The red overlay is composited into the drawing buffer: pixel-diff tests on the displayed canvas must set BRUSH_TARGET='fluid' and MASK_OVERLAY=false before reading (js/05j-update-loop.js:1275)
Mask FBO coverage is NOT resized with the canvas within a session in 05o itself; serialize/restore round-trips through PNG at FBO res (js/05o-masks.js:87-172)
stampMaskDab lazily calls ensureDefault - painting with target 'mask' and no mask silently creates 'Mask 1' (js/05i-sim-stats.js:314)

window.__obsStrengthMax (strength normalization, js/23-depth-collision.js:1286,1447)

Dye MASS: the obstacle drain removes dye pinned in walls at config.COLLIDER_DRAIN (default 0.06/frame, js/04a-canvas-gl-config.js:471) gated by COLLIDER_FLOW_KEEP / COLLIDER_DRAIN_DILATE - collider on/off changes total-dye metrics

config knobs: DEPTH_EDGE_BAND, COLLIDER_GAP_FILL, COLLIDER_ALPHA_SOLID, CURL_WALL_GATE, WALL_SLIP, COLLIDER_FLOW_KEEP, COLLIDER_DRAIN, COLLIDER_DRAIN_DILATE (js/04a-canvas-gl-config.js:383-479, 581-592)
layers[] / layerOrder[] when created via createFromMask/createFromLayerMask (collision layers are real layer entries with panel DOM, js/23-depth-collision.js:594-749)

The obstacle is re-uploaded after every FBO reinit (js/05j-update-loop.js:220-222) - resize mid-test recomposites walls
Depth estimation (refreshDepth / DepthEstimator) downloads a ~25MB model and is async - avoid in deterministic tests; use setProcedural or mask sources instead (js/23-depth-collision.js:60-107)

Collider coverage semantics: coverage = SHAPE not texture; mid-alpha source pixels are saturated by the COLLIDER_ALPHA_SOLID knee in both GPU and CPU paths (js/23-depth-collision.js:1448-1472, js/04a-canvas-gl-config.js:406-414)

features.name: photoSafe
features.activate: var t = document.getElementById('photoSafeToggle'); t.checked = true; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); /* default-ON; activation only needed after a test disabled it */
features.deactivate: var t = document.getElementById('photoSafeToggle'); t.checked = false; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));
touchesSharedState: localStorage 'fluidui.photoSafe' — persisted preference; also read by 04a config seed and the first-frame warning modal
localStorage 'fluidui.photoWarn.ack.v1' — modal acknowledgement; clear it to re-show the warning on next load
body.photosafe-on class — CSS transitions on canvas background/opacity
safeFrame/safeOut/safeLuma/safeStats FBOs via window.__getPhotoSafe() — safeStats is 2x1: texel0 {R:envelope, G:slewLuma, B:mean}, texel1 {R:lastSign+1, G:pairTimer, B:transitionRate}
knownHazards: Default ON: A/B captures against pre-feature baselines must disable it OR rely on pass-through bit-identity (verified for static scenes; any detected flash breaks identity BY DESIGN)
applyPhotoSafe uses its own wall-clock dt — virtual-clock harnesses do not pace the limiter; drive real time or expect envelope decay to run on wall time
The limiter reacts to the FINAL frame: a test that strobes any visual (glow, background, splats) >3Hz will see amplitudes crushed while ON — that is the feature working
photoSafeToggle is in PRESET_SKIP: preset/vault/multiplayer snapshots neither carry nor apply it; do not expect applyPresetSnapshot to change it
Exports/captures/recordings read the canvas AFTER the limiter: a mid-strobe export is the CLAMPED look (intended — what the viewer was protected into seeing is what ships)

Alpha-channel flashes (backgroundTransparency strobing the DOM composite) are outside the GL limiter; the CSS transition guard on body.photosafe-on covers background-color/opacity of the canvas elements, nothing else
OFF->ON edge clears limiter state via resetPhotoSafeState() (05i, called from 05j); buffers are allocated lazily when booted with protection off — window.__photoSafeEnsure() builds them

Detection is OSCILLATION RATE, not per-frame deviation: a test that changes the frame monotonically (painting, fades, a single burst) will NOT engage the envelope by design. To exercise suppression, alternate large-area luminance at >2.5Hz for ~1s (engagement ramps over ~0.8s; WCAG permits up to 3 flashes/sec, so onset is not instant).
The live rAF loop keeps running between harness tool calls and releases envelope/rate (tau 1s / PHOTOSAFE_RELEASE) — build the strobe AND read the state inside ONE evaluation.

features.name: scatterOcclusion
features.activate: window.config.GLOW=true; window.config.SCATTER=true; var t=document.getElementById('scatterBlockToggle'); t.checked=true; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); /* needs a collision layer to have any effect */
features.deactivate: var t=document.getElementById('scatterBlockToggle'); t.checked=false; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
touchesSharedState: obstacle FBO via window.__getObstacle() — READ ONLY here; the pointer swaps with obstacleScratch every composite, never cache it
window.__obsStrengthMax — the coverage normalizer; raw texels store coverage*collisionStrength
texture unit 1 during the scatter pass (the rest of the glow chain uses only unit 0)
knownHazards: No-op without BOTH a collision layer and Scatter on — a test that forgets the collider sees zero difference and looks like a failure
updateObstacleFromLayers() is rAF-COALESCED: window.update() does not pump rAF, so after changing colliders you must await a real animation frame before the obstacle reflects it
collisionLayers.enabled=false calls clearObstacle(), so re-enabling needs a recomposite plus a real rAF frame
Probe the obstacle by reading channel R ONLY — it is R16F, so averaging RGBA reports 1/3 of the true coverage
Dye decays between harness tool calls; repaint inside the same evaluation or the emitter is gone and every scatter reading collapses to ~0

Shadow edge sharpness is bounded by config.SCATTER_RESOLUTION (default 512, capped at the canvas long side). Scatter is sized INDEPENDENTLY of GLOW_RESOLUTION: at glow's 256 base the march undersampled the 512-wide obstacle 2:1 and shadow boundaries stair-stepped. Measured edge roughness vs texel size: 256 -> mean 21.4px / p95 224px; 512 -> 11.8 / 8.0; 1024 -> 7.0 / 6.5.

Benchmarking the scatter pass needs gl.finish() AND a frozen scene (DENSITY_DISSIPATION=1, timeScale~0, no new splats) — dye density drift otherwise swamps the signal and yields non-monotonic/negative costs. Even then the pass is below the noise floor on a 4090.
